raw_blocks: At Rush Street Interactive (NYSE: RSI) we exist to ignite the thrill of winning with players no matter where they find themselves. We pride ourselves on creating amazing integrated experiences that keep players engaged in our games.
At Rush Street Interactive we are building highly recognizable and approachable brands. Brands designed with the experience in-mind, that aim to be friendly, fun, and fair to all our valued players.
It’s a whole new game.

BetRivers is one of North America's most popular and fastest-growing Online Casino and Sportsbooks. Designed to be the most player-centric Online Casino and Sportsbook brand, BetRivers offers more moments of delight for our players through a wide range of bonus features creating more opportunities for our players to win!

Welcome to one of Latin America's largest Online Casino and Sportsbook. RushBet offers Latin America's greatest variety of slots, roulette, blackjack games, and sports betting options, giving our players more opportunities to win and helping our passionate players feel the rush of online play.
One of Pennsylvania's most popular Online Casino and Sportsbook brands, PlaySugarHouse brings the magic of the casino and sportsbook floor to players wherever they choose to play.
RSI is an industry leader in delivering market-proven online, social, and land-based, real-money gaming products across the Americas.

We understand the consumer. We use real insights to build experiences that fit our players' gaming needs. We're collaborators and free-thinkers. We thrive on innovation. We're building relationships with our players that last.

We’re in the entertainment business, and so we strive to build interesting and memorable experiences to our players. We offer one of the largest game libraries in the industry, rich with community chat, live dealers, tournaments, and much more.
Well-rounded demographics and a focus on retention have been the cornerstones of our growth since 2012.
A Passion for Passionate People
At RSI, we believe our people are our greatest asset. Excited by innovation and excellence? Learn more about RSI careers and company culture.

raw_blocks: Rush Street Interactive (NYSE: RSI) was founded in 2012 with the ambition to create the most fun, friendly, and fair online gaming platform in the Americas.
We exist to ignite the thrill of winning with players anytime and anywhere. We pride ourselves on creating innovative and integrated gaming experiences.

At RSI, we're not only market leaders, but we also strive to be first-to-market with our innovations. We're building bridges between online, social, and land-based gaming businesses to create amazing, integrated experiences that keep players in the game.
A Passion for Passionate People

RSI is fueled by the people who drive our business day-in and day-out. We're dedicated to treating everyone with respect and trust. We embrace personal freedom and responsibility. We trust our team to make tough decisions - and we empower them to get stuff done. Most importantly, we like having fun along the way.
Personal Growth is Business Growth

We believe that the success of our business is directly correlated with the growth of our people. We invest significant time engaged with real conversations with our people. We help our team members set and strive for audacious personal and professional goals. As a fast-growing company in an emerging industry, every member of our team has a huge impact on defining our culture.

We value openness and transparency in everything we do. No matter what level of seniority, every RSI Employee has real access to leadership - all the way to our CEO. We genuinely believe that open and honest communication shapes the foundation of a strong team - every opinion and fresh idea matters here.

We create joy with purpose and learning. Fun at RSI is intentional. We take smart risks, move quickly, embrace change and bring energy to meaningful work by creating experiences that delight players and inspire teams.

We lead with respect, empathy, and clear agreed-upon expectations. Being friendly means being people-first and performance-driven. We build trust through thoughtful communication, open collaboration, and addressing issues clearly.

We act with integrity, transparency, accountability, and responsibility. Fairness guides how we decide and deliver. We operate with honesty and consistency, listening to different perspectives and taking responsibility for both our actions and their outcomes.

We move with clarity, urgency, and ownership toward what matters most. Focus at RSI means aligning clearly, prioritizing intentionally, and following through to achieve measurable impact of our players and the business. We invest our time and energy where it creates the greatest value.

We believe that innovation begins with individuals and that truly game changing ideas can come from anyone. We don't hire smart people and tell them what to do, we ask them what to do! Our leadership is dedicated to maintaining a collaborative culture where every voice can be heard and where new ideas can take root.

“ I love RSI's culture of freedom and flexibility. I have freedom to work from various locations, in office or remotely. Freedom to ask questions, make mistakes and try new approaches. For such a regulated field, the company provides good flexibility in terms of working processes and adjusting them for the teams, which helps with collaboration between teams in different time zones. ”

“ I’m grateful to be part of RSI, a team that challenges me to grow while offering unwavering support. In an environment that fosters autonomy and innovation, I love that my voice is heard and that I have both the freedom and support to succeed. ”

“ There are a lot of smart and helpful people in RSI with a "can-do" attitude which makes this a great place to work. Together with the freedom to choose how to solve any particular problem, it makes RSI a great place to do awesome things with awesome people. ”
“ The work-life balance is a great benefit at RSI. My well-being is enhanced, since I now have more time to enjoy my favorite activities. ”

RSI is consistently recognized as an exemplary employer, technological innovator, and leader in customer service. Our track record of success is a testimony to the spirit of our team and their dedication to our core values.
Customer Service Operator of the Year
Social Gaming Operator of the Year
Casino Operator of the Year
Customer Social Gaming Operator of the Year
Digital Operator of the Year

raw_blocks: Rush Street Interactive operates regulated Online Casinos in 8 iGaming markets that consistently rank among the top-performing brands by revenue in each jurisdiction. The differentiated user experience and market-leading retention rates delivered by this product were instrumental in our recognition as the "Mobile Operator of the Year" in North America at the EGR North America Awards 2019 and "American Operator of the Year" & "Casino Operator of the Year" at the American Gambling Awards in 2019.

Our Sportsbook is changing the game for fans. Using the Rush Street Interactive proprietary platform, we were the first company to launch legal online sportsbooks in Pennsylvania (PlaySugarHouse & BetRivers) as well as Colorado, Indiana, Illinois, and Ontario (BetRivers). Our award-winning sites continue to grow market share in large part due to the quality of the user experience, including innovative features, gamified promotions & loyalty programs, and responsive customer service.

Rush Street Interactive has successfully deployed several instances of complete and state-of-the-art Sportsbook solutions in retail venues. We were the first to open a legal sportsbook in the state of New York and Illinois. We also operate 8 in-casino sportsbooks, including marquee locations at Rivers Casino in Pittsburgh (PA), Philadelphia (PA), and Portsmouth (VA) and the historic French Lick Resort (IN).
Social Gaming (Casino & Sportsbook)

Our new Social Gaming Casino & Sportsbook products allows users to experience all the fun of our Online Gaming products in a casual, free-to-play setting. We use the same platform for Social Gaming as for our Online Gaming, which enables our partners to cost-effectively pre-register qualified bettors in advance of iGaming legalization.

BetRivers Poker delivers a fun and fair experience with streamlined gameplay and transparent policies that let players focus on what they love: the game itself. Features like Dynamic Avatars add a human element to online poker, providing easy-to-use player reads while ensuring safety and privacy with Table Aliases. No unfair advantages—just pure poker.

RSI has developed a gamified promotional platform that delivers a diverse and growing set of internally-developed promotional tools and games. Our technology is designed to drive player engagement and entertainment, including real-time algorithmic-bonusing engines, scratch cards, wheel spins, bad beat bonuses, promotional bingo, and an innovative multi-player platform that powers our unique online slot tournaments. Our technology gives players greater control over their account management, enabling users to activate bonus money whenever and in whatever increments they desire. Players can also track in real-time, progress against cash conversions and bonus point accumulation.

Our platform was built on the premise that customer acquisition is important for growth, but retention is key for profitability . This platform leverages a suite of technologies that together provide a leading management, administrative, reporting and regulatory compliance end-to-end solution to power our operations. It incorporates multiple sophisticated technologies and provides a central back-office function to efficiently manage player accounts, payments, risk and a wide range of proprietary bonusing and loyalty programs and features. Our platform is designed to ensure we deliver a seamless experience for both players and gaming operators.
